summary.allegation: The cardholder says they ordered clothing on 22 March 2025 for GBP 189.99 and never received the package, and that two contacts with the merchant produced no resolution.
summary.to_defend: The merchant must show carrier proof of delivery to the cardholder's address on or before the chargeback date.

justification: Represent: R1 is satisfied by Royal Mail tracking RM98421144GB showing a signed delivery to the cardholder's address, with R3 and R4 also met.
rationale:
The cardholder disputes a GBP 189.99 purchase made on 22 March 2025 on the basis that the goods never arrived.
Royal Mail tracking RM98421144GB for order #NT-44912 shows the item posted from Leeds on 23 March 2025 and delivered at 11:47 on 24 March 2025, signed for in the name WHITFORD.
Delivery was made to 22 Cavendish Court, London SW4 7QR, the same address given as both billing and shipping address at purchase.
The transaction was authenticated by 3DS with AVS result Y and CVV result M, confirming the cardholder's address and card details.
Delivery on 24 March 2025 precedes the 18 April 2025 chargeback date, so the goods were received before the dispute was raised.
analyst_notes: Ask the merchant for the scanned signature image held on file for RM98421144GB in case the issuer challenges the signature.
Request copies of the two customer contacts referenced by the issuer to show the merchant did respond.
